metadata.description: GTM strategy skills for IT agencies — a 13-step cold-audit flow plus a standalone 23-criteria GTM audit; outputs a full go-to-market strategy and a 30-90-180 action plan to Notion; plus research, forecasting, growth and hiring skills and 3 planning tools.

plugins.name: gtm-strategy
plugins.description: Cold-audit GTM strategy flow for IT agencies: 13 steps + orchestrator + a standalone 23-criteria GTM audit (stage -> ICP/market -> sizing -> competitor/GAP -> positioning -> value prop -> offers -> buyer journey -> materials/channels/docs -> 30-90-180 action plan). Outputs to Notion in Ukrainian. Plus 7 research and planning skills (competitor finder, market urgency research, call-transcript persona insights, GTM idea stress test, revenue forecast, growth planner, sales hiring brief) and 3 planning tools: capacity plan, risk assessment, status report (Anthropic, Apache-2.0).
